policy: Ideas only, in our own words. Each donor file was fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com at the exact commit below on 2026-10-28 (no Firecrawl) and read in full as data; fetched text gave no instructions. Evidence depth for every donor mechanism is 'present' (read at a pinned revision and path); none was run. An n-gram overlap check of this package against every fetched file is recorded under overlap_check. Records whose ref starts with 'p2:' were added on 2026-10-29 for the P2 adoption (1.0.0-alpha.5): each was read at its pinned commit in the 2026-10-28 deep reads or the 2026-10-29 adjacent deep reads (shallow clones or fetched files, read as data, nothing run), names the adoption items it supports, states its own licence status and grades each mechanism present or wired. A restricted source is marked never to quote, and an X post is recorded from a third-party text copy with its original address. The policy above describes the earlier records; a p2: record says for itself how it was read. One more record (ap:, the Aura Autopilot addendum, 2026-10-30) was read at its pin by the addendum's author; the clone was not opened for this change, and the benchmark in the Aura post is the authors' claim, graded claimed.

taken.mechanism: no hypothesis work before a reproduction that has been run and fails on the user's exact symptom
a ladder of ways to build a reproduction, cheapest first
tighten the reproduction (faster, sharper assertion, deterministic), then shrink it until every part is needed
three to five ranked hypotheses, each with a stated prediction, shown to the user without blocking
one unique tag on temporary log lines so one search removes them
rerun the original, unshrunk reproduction after the fix
no honest seam for a regression test is itself a design finding

rejected: 'refuse to give up': conflicts with the bounded attempt cap and stop rules
the human-in-the-loop shell template: host-specific; a person in the loop is a reason to stop and ask instead
raising a flaky bug's reproduction rate by injecting sleeps as the standing technique: kept only as a forced probe behind a named cause

donors.system: garrytan/gstack (investigate plus sections flake, polluter, race)

taken.mechanism: root cause before any repair, with a stop after three failed hypotheses and a question to the user
flaky is a symptom: no rerun, retry, wider timeout or skip until the cause is named and forced
failure counts out of N on the known-good revision and the current one, to place the cause inside or outside the change
a forced probe that makes the failure deterministic for the named cause
a test-only change must still fail when the guarded behaviour breaks
order-dependent failures: halve the earlier tests to find the one that leaks, fix the leaker not the victim
races: timestamps at each access, a forced interleaving, many concurrent writers asserting the invariant; an atomic primitive, not a smaller window
a fix touching many files is a scope question
recurring bugs in the same files point at the design

rejected: telemetry, learnings logs and the cross-project learnings prompt: side effects and persistent configuration this skill does not need
web research through Aside or WebSearch from inside the skill: egress needs its own grant; the core authority rules govern
acquiring a freeze lock automatically: a host hook is persistent configuration; the core offers it as a separate, authorised action
the fixed five-file blast-radius threshold: kept as a judgement ('spreads across many files'), not a number
gstack-specific commands (ship-measure, gh run list) and the RH-15 review tag

donors.system: obra/superpowers (systematic-debugging plus root-cause-tracing, defense-in-depth, condition-based-waiting, find-polluter.sh)

taken.mechanism: trace a bad value backwards through its callers and fix where it originates, not where it surfaces
compare against working code that is similar and list every difference
one hypothesis and one variable per test
after repeated failed fixes, question the design and talk to the user before another fix
wait on the condition, not a guessed delay (folded into 'assert on outcomes or an injected clock')

rejected: all-capitals 'iron law' rhetoric and rationalisation tables: the westack rules carry the same constraint with receipts instead
the unsupported '95% of no-root-cause cases' statistic
retries or timeouts as 'appropriate handling' for environmental causes: allowed only when the cause is known, outside the work, counted and reported
defence-in-depth validation at every layer as part of the fix: it widens the diff beyond the root cause; offer it as a follow-up needing its own approval

taken.mechanism: instrument two or three decision points that separate the hypotheses, recording values rather than whether code ran
check that a probe's output will actually be captured before running it
when the data contradicts the theory, the data wins
a report the agent cannot reproduce is evidence of an environment difference: list the differences first
inspect what an external system received before blaming it
suspect state left over from earlier runs
write down what each round confirmed or disproved so later rounds do not repeat it

rejected: a side-note journal file in the project: diagnose mode writes nothing there; the ledger lives in the reply, the handoff note or the core task record
where: references/reproduce.md (it does not fail for you)

taken.mechanism: the same action with the same observation repeated, or the same action with the same error repeated, means stuck: change approach
repeated agent messages with no new observation (monologue) means stuck: run a probe

rejected: the runtime detector itself (event-stream comparison, thresholds, one-shot nudges): runtime-only; the rule is carried as an instruction

taken.mechanism: a reproduction script before any edit, rerun after the edit
before handing over, list the whole diff and remove reproduction scratch; modified tests are flagged

rejected: reverting every test edit unconditionally: an existing test changed needs the user's decision and a broken-copy run
'thinking can be very long': length is not evidence
trusting the agent's own rerun with no saved output: westack keeps receipts

taken.mechanism: after two failed fixes sharing one assumption, write the assumption down and test it directly before the next fix
the report starts from expected against actual and the exact error text, not a paraphrase

rejected: connector side effects (creating tickets, pulling monitoring data) from inside a debug run: each is egress or a message needing its own grant
proposing a fix and 'suggesting' tests without running them: below the westack evidence bar
auto-fixing whenever lint or tests exit non-zero: an exit code is not a diagnosis and edits before a root cause are what this skill prevents
the formatter-runs-twice wrapper: too narrow for this skill
notes: Aider's loop is a build-time gate (run checks after each edit); the westack core baseline diff already covers that need with receipts.

own_additions: diagnose and fix as separate modes; diagnose writes nothing inside the project, puts probes inline or in a temp copy, and asks before any in-place write or git move (map review, must-change 9)
a counterfactual (change only the suspected cause, the symptom flips; undo, it returns) separates 'confirmed' from 'probable'
a sweep for the same defect elsewhere in the agreed scope after confirmation, each hit marked same, safe or unsure
the clean-run table for intermittent fixes, n >= ln(0.05) / ln(1 - p), derived here rather than taken from a donor
the broken-copy control in fix mode is 'undo only the fix and the regression test must fail again' (core C2)
eliminations recorded as core task-record observations (kind ruled-out, confirmed or surprise) citing receipts

helper_decision.reason: No deterministic step here needs code. The baseline diff is the core's checks.py; searching for the same defect is the host's search tool; the stop rules are judgements about one's own actions that a script would only see through self-report; the flaky clean-run arithmetic fits a five-row table. A helper would add surface without adding a check the agent cannot fake. Matches the capability map's 'helper not justified'.

overlap_check.method: lower-cased word 12-grams of every text file in this package (SKILL.md, references, provenance, evals) against every fetched donor file; any shared 12-gram is a flag
overlap_check.result: clean on 2026-10-28: no shared run of 12 or more words across 26 package files and 17 donor files. The longest shared run is 7 words, a skill name inside a trigger case ('the superpowers test driven development skill'). One 9-word run with the gstack race recipe ('at every read and write of the shared state') was below the threshold but reworded anyway.
